biggest_catch: Officially, selling on Depop is free in the US, UK, and Australia — no Depop selling fee; the seller's only unavoidable cost is the payment processing fee.
catches: US/UK/AU sellers pay no Depop selling fee per official Depop materials; standard payment processing fees still apply.
US payment processing is widely reported at 3.3% + $0.45 per transaction in 2026 coverage (not on the fetched official pages — use Depop's help centre for the current figure before pricing).
Buyers pay a separate marketplace fee of up to 5% of the item price plus up to $1 — this is buyer-paid, not seller cost.
Optional Boosted Listings cost extra (third-party 2026 reports vary: 8-12%) — only if the boost drives the sale.
Sellers outside the US/UK/Australia still pay a 10% selling fee per 2026 coverage.

maximize: Depop is the cheapest fashion resale platform for US sellers — 0% selling fee beats Mercari's 10% and Poshmark's 20%, so cross-list fashion items here first. The fee base for payment processing covers item price plus shipping and tax, so keep shipping efficient. Never turn on Boosted Listings casually (it costs extra per sale attributed to the boost). Refresh any pre-mid-2024 listings so they're on the current fee structure. Check Depop's help centre for the current processing-fee figure before pricing.

work_available: Depop is active and open to new sellers in the US, UK, and Australia.
what_gets_accepted: Listings are accepted for legal items; buyers pay a separate marketplace fee of up to 5% + $1 at checkout (buyer-paid, not your cost).
costs_and_unpaid_time: No Depop selling fee for US/UK/AU sellers, but standard payment processing fees apply (~3.3% + $0.45 in the US per 2026 coverage — confirm the current figure in Depop's help centre before pricing). when_cash_arrives: Your sale credits your Depop balance and payouts to your bank typically take a few business days. Exact payout timing wasn't confirmed on official pages during verification — check Depop's help centre before you sell.
